{"reason":"Add a high-confidence conjunct. V1’s 0.714 false-arbitration rate occurs despite 1.0 recall; this rejects six of eight shown false rows (confidence 0.44–0.67) while leaving magnitude, exposure, and frozen-horizon handling intact, reducing false arbitration while targeting the ≥0.8 recall gate.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
